title: Default folder for new projects on any drive
user_story: As the researcher I choose once where new projects are created (for example another drive) and still pick a specific folder per project when I want.

requirements.description: ui.projects_root (absolute path) is where projects without an explicit folder are created; explicit folders win; empty keeps <app data>/projects; relative paths are refused; existing projects are never reused or moved.

nonfunctional: Data never written inside the installation folder when a root is set
acceptance_criteria: New project under the chosen root

scenarios.expected: Created under the chosen root, duplicate names get a suffix
Explicit folder wins; empty root keeps app folder

recovery: Clear ui.projects_root. TASK-PROJECTS-ROOT-662, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real config and project creation in temporary folders.

tdd.scope: RED: 2 FAIL before implementation. GREEN: 3/3 PASS.
